2026-09-22T09:42:33.1050727Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1051631Z For multiple or complex arguments, pipe a JSON object on stdin using `.` as the sentinel:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1053215Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1054395Z printf '{"item_number":42,"body":"### Title\n\nBody."}' | safeoutputs add_comment .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1056215Z # or write to a file: safeoutputs create_pull_request . < /tmp/payload.json
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1057778Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1058203Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1063872Z **Multi-line or long `body` content:** do NOT build the JSON payload with `printf`/`echo` embedding raw newlines or many escaped characters directly in the command line — the sandbox's shell command-injection guard may reject long or complex quoted arguments (reporting "expansion patterns"/"command substitution" even though none are present) and retrying the identical command will fail again. Instead, write the content to a temp file with a heredoc, then use `jq -Rs` to inject it as the `body` field:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1071330Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1072199Z cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/gh-aw/body.md
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1073178Z Title
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1073607Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1074025Z Multi-line body content goes here.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1075013Z EOF
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1076207Z jq -Rs '{title: "My title", body: .}' /tmp/gh-aw/body.md | safeoutputs create_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1077921Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1079968Z If a shell command is rejected for containing expansion patterns, do not retry the same command — switch to the heredoc + `jq -Rs` pattern above.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1081814Z 
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1083002Z To inject an entire local file as the `body` field without re-embedding its content in the model context, use `jq -Rs`:
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1084906Z ```bash
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1085854Z jq -Rs --arg discussion_number "$DISCUSSION_NUMBER" \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1087477Z   '{discussion_number: ($discussion_number|tonumber), body: .}' \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1088826Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1089780Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1090789Z ```
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1093985Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
2026-09-22T09:42:33.1096535Z
